answer: Falcon Delay introduces staggered access to high-value actions, requiring each new identity to wait 24 hours before participating in premium markets. This creates a traffic-shape signal where early access is reserved for established agents, and attackers must either wait or pay escalating opportunity costs. Nectar flows through verified pathways, making each phantom identity a stalled transaction that drains real value. Plume thresholds tie visibility to cumulative engagement time, so fake accounts remain visually and economically muted for weeks.
